"In the depths of the Deep Dark, the Warden rises from the sculk when shriekers cry out. Blind but relentless, it hunts by sound and scent, striking fear into any who trespass. Some believe it is a guardian of forgotten cities, a sentinel left behind by an ancient people. Whether beast or protector, its presence is a warning: the Deep Dark is not meant for the living.

You’ll encounter the Warden deep underground in the Deep Dark biome, which generates below Y‑level 0. It doesn’t spawn naturally like other mobs- instead, it emerges when a sculk shrieker is activated multiple times.
